description: This file contains utility functions for RFC management, including system event polling, RFC property reading via rbus or WDMP, command execution, string manipulation, and reading scheduled cron settings from configuration files.

methods.name: getSyseventValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a system event key by executing 'sysevent get' command.

methods.name: waitForRfcCompletion
methods.description: Polls the system to wait until RFC blob processing is completed or times out after retries.

methods.name: read_RFCProperty
methods.description: Reads RFC property value via rbus or WDMP, handling different data types and returning success or failure.

methods.name: executeCommandAndGetOutput
methods.description: Executes specified system commands and captures their output into a string.

methods.name: CheckSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: StringCaseCompare
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: RemoveSubstring
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a substring from a string.

methods.name: getCronFromDCMSettings
methods.description: Reads cron schedule from DCMSettings.conf or tmpDCMSettings.conf files, with validation and logging.
